data.name: Pluralys
data.detailed_description:
You play Elie who's 16 years old. A teenager with no story, curious, a bit of a dreamer, a fan of video games. He/She (your choice!) loves spending his afternoons role-playing with his two best friends, Gab and Medie. Elie lives in Sector G with his mother and little sister, who can be a bit of a handful (but at this age, that's only to be expected).

The world around Elie seems ordinary. People go to work, deal with their daily worries... In short, everything is normal (well, the Zeings aren't but that's another matter). One day, your life changes as someone contacts you on Messenger Plus!. A strange person suddenly tells you the one thing every potential hero has always heard before: “you're the only one who can change the course of things”.

But why you? And above all... are you ready to trust them? This game is brought to you by a team of dedicated developers from Canada. 2 years of hard work, no AI whatsoever, all original content created by a group of RPG loving game developers :-). We hope you'll enjoy!

Pluralys is a world that is both familiar and profoundly strange. There, you will encounter beings from elsewhere, living among humans.

What do we still have to find out about them? Do they intend to settle on your planet forever? Can some of them be your friend? All of them? That may be up to you!

The mysterious person who contacted you has entrusted you with a strange device: the Pager.

This unique tool is capable of freezing time and revealing details no one else can see.
With it, you can analyze people, move objects far too heavy for a teenager, hack into security systems, and much more…

Of course, not every situation requires a pager (tell that to people in the 90s).

Pluralys is a living world, full of challenges big and small, as well as several mini-games scattered throughout your journey: choose wisely, solve puzzles, confront enigmas… this game is full of interactions that will let you explore the world in new and surprising ways.

Your journey will sometimes be peaceful, sometimes filled with obstacles, but it will always take you through varied, warm, and unexpected environments: quiet residential areas, lively bazaars, vast deserts, mysterious laboratories…

Each location has its own story and each one brings you a little closer to the truth.

Narrative is at the heart of Pluralys

Throughout your adventure, you will encounter short cinematic scenes sometimes touching, sometimes funny, sometimes mysterious that deepen the relationship between characters and reveal more about the world’s hidden stakes. There's no combat in this game, only choices that matter.

data.short_description: Pluralys is an RPG focused on exploration, comedy and intrigue. You play Elie, a young person living a peaceful life, until unexpected visitors arrive and change everything. What seems like a quiet, cozy story hides a deeper mystery and many other adventures to discover.
data.supported_languages: French, English, Ukrainian, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
